text: {"lessons":["I should judge each position by its future risk and return, not by whether it is above or below my purchase price; realizing a gain feels good, but that alone is not a reason to sell.","Repeatedly trimming winners can reduce exposure, but I should avoid selling mechanically and consider the portfolio’s overall diversification and long-term plan.","Short-term account changes can be small or negative even when I realize gains, so I should review total portfolio performance rather than equating successful sales with successful investing."]}
